content: गाण्डि(ण्डी)वः, -वम् [गाण्डिरस्त्यस्य संज्ञायाम् व <ls>P. V. 2. 110</ls>] .²1 The bow of Arjuna, presented by Soma to Varuṇa, by Varuṇa to Agni, and by Agni to Arjuna, when the latter assisted him in consuming the खाण्डववन; गाण्डीवं स्रंसते हस्तात् <ls>Bg. 1. 29</ls>. .²2 A bow in general.
